description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LicenseDao component in the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations and license name existence checks related to the License entity, including setup with test fixtures.

classes.name: LicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending TestCase, testing LicenseDao data access operations including create, read, update, delete, and existence check functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes LicenseDao instance and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testAddLicense
methods.description: Tests adding a new License entity and verifies it is correctly saved.

methods.name: testEditLicense
methods.description: Tests editing an existing License entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License by ID and asserts the correct entity is returned.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Licenses and checks the result count and types.

methods.name: testDeleteLicenses
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple licenses and verifies the correct count of deletions.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Attempts to delete a non-existing License record and verifies zero deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if various case and whitespace variations of an existing License name are recognized as existing.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Fetches License by name with different cases and whitespace, asserting correct entity or absence.
